title: Quick Fix Yakimono Grill
description: A charred, crumbly, and quick-fix Ethiopian dish featuring ackee and yakimono-grill, suitable for a weeknight meal. This dish is vegan-friendly and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
Dust the ackee with teff flour, tossing to coat evenly.
Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the curry powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the bread crumbs and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ackee to the pan and stir to combine with the bread crumb mixture.
Transfer the ackee mixture to the preheated yakimono-grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until charred and crispy.
Garnish with chopped scallions, if desired.
